# Disagreement Log — GTH_101

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 101
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 101 | "in my way" | "as I do" | "the way I do" | *kata eme*: in my way vs. as I do |
| 2 | 101 | "will not be able to be a disciple to me" | "cannot be my disciple" | "cannot be my disciple" | Disciple phrase: formal vs. compressed |
| 3 | 101 | "my mother gave me death" | "my mother brought me death" | "my earthly mother gave me death" | First mother: give vs. bring; PNEUMA adds "earthly" |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "in my way" (preserves the idiomatic force of *kata eme*), "will not be able to be a disciple to me" (fuller rendering), and "my mother gave me death" (no added adjective — the mystery of the unspecified first mother stands).
